title: A Summit for the Rivergate
premise: Desert ranger Ivo Eastwick chases a thief named Sable Corren into the Rivergate, a canyon country where the great river rises from a source no one is permitted to see. When an upstream survey expedition goes silent, Ivo is conscripted as guide and tracker — only to discover Sable is among the missing, and the debt he carries belongs to her family. As the dry season drains the river and the expedition's secrets surface, Ivo must choose between delivering Sable to justice and following her into the forbidden source. In the end he reaches the springs with her, learns his debt was a lie told to bind him, and lets the river carry the truth downstream while they walk out together into the open desert.
about_author: Odile Sandoval is a former river guide who spent six seasons running cargo boats through canyon country before turning to writing full-time. She lives in a dry wash town where she keeps an unreliable garden and an even more unreliable compass.

chapters.title: The Weight of Nothing
chapters.summary: Ivo Eastwick tracks a thief across empty salt flats, carrying a compass and a paper of debt he has never questioned. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: lonely competence masking a hollow purpose.

chapters.title: Tracks in Salt
chapters.summary: The thief's trail leads toward the Rivergate, where rangers have no jurisdiction. Ivo finds a dropped locket bearing a name he recognizes from his debt papers. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: first crack in certainty.

chapters.title: Radio Silence
chapters.summary: At the Rivergate station, word arrives that the Meridian Survey expedition upriver has stopped answering its radio for nine days. The station chief conscripts Ivo — the only ranger who knows the upper canyons. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: duty closing like a trap.

chapters.title: The Last Boat
chapters.summary: Ivo joins a small rescue party led by surveyor Captain Anselm Voss, a man more invested in maps than people. They launch upstream against the current. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: reluctant commitment.

chapters.title: What the Water Keeps
chapters.summary: The party finds the survey's abandoned lower camp: cold fire, scattered instruments, a journal page torn out. Ivo reads boot prints that match the thief's stride exactly. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into obsession.

chapters.title: Sable
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: years ago, young Ivo witnessed a drowning at the source country's edge and signed a debt to the family of the dead man — Sable Corren's father. POV: Ivo (past). Emotional beat: grief he has never named.

chapters.title: Narrows
chapters.summary: The rescue party enters the Narrows, where the river runs fast between walls too sheer to climb. A flash flood nearly takes them; one porter quits. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: fear made physical.

chapters.title: The Second Camp
chapters.summary: They find the survey's middle camp intact but emptied, with a message scratched on a canteen: GOING TO THE SOURCE. Voss wants to turn back; Ivo refuses. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: defiance born of need.

chapters.title: Split Currents
chapters.summary: Voss splits the party; three follow him downriver, four go on with Ivo, including cartographer Wren Halloway, who suspects the survey found something it shouldn't have. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: new perspective, quiet suspicion.

chapters.title: The Thief Herself
chapters.summary: Ivo catches Sable Corren alive at a side canyon — starving, unrepentant, and carrying survey documents she stole before the expedition vanished. She claims the survey was hunting the source to sell it. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: enemy revealed as mirror.

chapters.title: Terms
chapters.summary: Sable bargains: her father's debt papers were forged by the survey's financier to buy Ivo's silence about what he saw as a boy. Ivo doesn't believe her — but doesn't let her go. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: trust and suspicion entangled.

chapters.title: Dry Season Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Wren calculates the river's fall: they have perhaps twenty days before the shallows strand them above the last rapids. Every mile upstream costs time they cannot buy back. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: the clock becomes a character.

chapters.title: Terrace Country
chapters.summary: The party crosses wind-carved terraces where Sable grew up; she shows them hidden seeps and old family marks on stone. Ivo sees the land through her memory. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: belonging shown, not told.

chapters.title: The Watcher
chapters.summary: Someone follows them — a lone rider on the rim, gone each time they look. Voss's downriver party radios once, garbled, then static. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: paranoia tightening.

chapters.title: What Ivo Saw
chapters.summary: Under pressure, Ivo admits the truth of his childhood: he saw men diverting the source's outflow, and a man drowned stopping them — Sable's father. He ran. The debt was hush money. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: shame finally spoken.

chapters.title: Cold Camp
chapters.summary: A freezing night with no fire; Sable and Ivo keep watch together and speak honestly for the first time — about fathers, debts, and the difference between guilt and responsibility. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: love beginning against both their wills.

chapters.title: The Rider Found
chapters.summary: They corner the watcher: a half-mad survivor of the survey, who reveals Voss's financier sent men to erase the expedition after it confirmed the source could be dammed and sold. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the conspiracy takes shape.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Ford
chapters.summary: The financier's hired men attack at a shallow crossing. Wren is wounded; the party loses most of its supplies and the radio dies for good. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: cost made real; no way back now.

chapters.title: Carrying Wren
chapters.summary: Slow days hauling the injured cartographer through slot canyons. Sable teaches Ivo her father's routes; the group stops being a rescue party and becomes something closer to a crew. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: fragile unity.

chapters.title: The Map That Lies
chapters.summary: Wren, feverish, confesses she altered the official maps years ago under orders — erasing the source approaches. Her guilt mirrors Ivo's. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: complicity confessed.

chapters.title: First Ascent
chapters.summary: To bypass a flooded gorge they must climb a route Sable's father pioneered. Ivo freezes halfway up, haunted; Sable talks him through it hand over hand. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: fear overcome with help — not alone.

chapters.title: Signs of the Survey
chapters.summary: Fresh cairns appear: the missing surveyors are alive and moving toward the source deliberately, led by their chief, who believes the source must be destroyed rather than sold or saved. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: the stakes twist again.

chapters.title: The Financier's Men
chapters.summary: The hired crew camps ahead of them, waiting at the last defensible pass. Sable proposes a deception using her knowledge of the terraces; Ivo argues for a direct fight. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: strategy versus pride.

chapters.title: The Long Detour
chapters.summary: A brutal two-day detour through waterless stone. They bury Wren's instruments to lighten load — Wren weeps over the maps. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: sacrifice of identity.

chapters.title: Night of the Falling Star
chapters.summary: A meteor storm lights the high plateau; the party rests and dreams. Sable tells Ivo why she stole the documents: to prove her father died protecting the water, not stealing it. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: tenderness under open sky.

chapters.title: The Pass Held
chapters.summary: Ivo doubles back alone at night and springs Sable's trap, scattering the hired men without killing — proving he can be something other than his employers' instrument. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: moral victory, physical exhaustion.

chapters.title: Above the Trees
chapters.summary: They cross the timberline into country no map records, following water smell and birdsong. The debt papers burn in the cook fire; Ivo watches them curl. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: release he doesn't yet trust.

chapters.title: The Surveyors
chapters.summary: They find the missing team alive but divided — half want to seal the source forever, half to sell it. Their chief, gaunt and certain, greets Ivo by name: he knows what Ivo saw as a boy. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: past and present colliding.

chapters.title: Arguments at the Threshold
chapters.summary: A council at the final canyon mouth: destroy, sell, or reveal. Ivo argues for revelation — let the world see and decide. The chief calls him naive; Sable stands with him. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: conviction tested publicly.

chapters.title: Betrayal
chapters.summary: During the night, two surveyors slip away to signal the financier's main force, which has been climbing the river all along. The radio-less party learns it when flares bloom far below. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: hope punctured.

chapters.title: The Race for the Springs
chapters.summary: A desperate climb up the final gorge as the hired force ascends behind them. Wren, barely able to walk, insists on coming to map the source properly — her act of repair. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: determination over brokenness.

chapters.title: The Source
chapters.summary: They reach it: a cathedral cavern where the entire river rises from living rock, vast and silent. Even the hardened surveyors go quiet. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: awe that dissolves argument.

chapters.title: The Chief's Choice
chapters.summary: The survey chief prepares demolition charges to collapse the cavern — better dead than owned. Ivo and Sable confront him with the truth of his own expedition logs: his patron planned to poison the water after purchase. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: fury turned to grief.

chapters.title: Standoff in the Cathedral
chapters.summary: The financier's men arrive; the chief detonates only the entrance charge, sealing everyone inside together in the dark. Trapped, enemies and allies face each other by lamplight around the rising water. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: climax — every conflict compressed into one chamber.

chapters.title: Water Rising
chapters.summary: With the spring flooding the sealed cavern, Ivo organizes rivals into a single work party to reopen the passage, using Sable's father's old diversion channels. The financier's foreman, seeing the truth in the logs, switches sides. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: enemies made crew.

chapters.title: The Breaking
chapters.summary: They breach the wall as the water peaks; the river explodes outward, scattering the hired force and washing the evidence — the logs, the forged debt — downstream toward the towns. POV: Sable. Emotional beat: catharsis; the river itself delivers judgment.

chapters.title: Aftermath in the Cavern Light
chapters.summary: Survivors regroup. The chief surrenders his authority to Wren's honest maps; the foreman agrees to testify. Ivo and Sable stand at the spring's edge and finally speak plainly of love without debt or duty framing it. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: quiet resolution of the heart.

chapters.title: Downstream
chapters.summary: The long descent as the dry season ends and early rains swell the river. They carry Wren, escort prisoners, and pass the burned camps without stopping. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: homeward gravity.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: At the Rivergate station, testimony is given; the forgery of Ivo's debt is entered into record and voided. Voss returns, chastened. Ivo resigns his commission rather than serve the men who bought his silence. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: justice imperfect but real.

chapters.title: Open Country
chapters.summary: Ivo and Sable walk out of the Rivergate together onto the open flats — no warrant, no debt, no map. She carries her father's compass; he carries nothing he didn't choose. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: belonging chosen freely; the story closes on the horizon.
